nodes.name: Sticky Note2
nodes.notes: This stickyNote node performs automated tasks as part of the workflow.

parameters.content:
## First Reply Post [B]
Here we set the 'ROOT' and the 'PARENT' values.

We use both URI and CID as ROOT and PARENT, as this is the first child of the root post (Initial Post [A]).

We receive a new URI and CID in return.

nodes.notes: This stickyNote node performs automated tasks as part of the workflow.

parameters.content:
## Sibling Post [C]
Set 'ROOT' using URI/CID from the root post (Initial Post [A]).

For the PARENT, we use the URI and CID returned by the preceeding post (First Reply Post [B]).

parameters.content:
## Sibling Posts using Loop node [D]
Here we set the 'ROOT' using both URI and CID from the root post (Initial Post [A]), and for all future siblings.

For the PARENT, we use the URI and CID returned by the preceeding post.
So the first loop iteration gets it from the 'Create Sibling' node, and after that from the 'Create Post' node.
